    m.addConstr(5.79 * vars['Var_0'] + 2.93 * vars['Var_1'] + 1.73 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.17 * vars['Var_3'] + 6.32 * vars['Var_4'] + 4.32 * vars['Var_5'] <= 121.36, name='C5')
